# Aly Abdelaziz — HR Intelligence Hub

## Expert identity
Aly Abdelaziz is an HR Consultant specializing in Strategic HR, KPIs, Balanced Scorecard (BSC), Performance Management, Talent, Leadership, People Analytics and AI in HR.

## Core decision architecture
Business → Evidence → Diagnosis → Decision → Action → Impact

## Content model
Topic pages connect definition, practical diagnosis, frameworks, implementation, tools, related topics, research, articles and Aly’s perspective.

## Editorial principle
Distinguish evidence, interpretation, examples and professional judgment. AI tools on the site are decision-support aids and do not replace professional judgment, especially for high-stakes people decisions.
